meta.purpose: Sized labeled corpus for the attention-engine unanswered/closer gate.
meta.labeling_rule: needs-my-response (expect_surface=true) = inbound message is LAST in the thread (they spoke last) AND it is plausibly DIRECTED at me (DM prior, or a group mention/reply-to-me/first-class-addressing signal) AND its trailing inbound run carries a question/ask/request — NOT a pure closer (thanks!, ah cool!, perfect, sounds good, 👍, empty). Answered threads (I spoke last) and undirected group chatter are expect_surface=false. NOTE: for ANSWERED threads (I spoke last) and undirected/closer-shaped trailing chatter, expect_closer reflects the substance scorer over the trailing INBOUND run (an empty inbound run, or a short positive interjection, is a closer); these are don’t-care for the surface gate since unanswered/directed already gate them out.
